faq.heroSub: Browse our knowledge base or search for a topic below.
faq.g1a: SKINWAVE is an instant CS2 skin buyout service. We buy your Counter-Strike 2 skins directly for real money - no waiting for buyers, no auctions. Get paid via card, crypto, bank transfer or site balance.
faq.g2a: Yes. We use Steam's official OpenID authentication - we never ask for your password. All trades go through Steam's trading system. Your order status is tracked in real time and all operations are logged.
faq.g3a: Click "Sign In" in the top right corner. You'll be redirected to Steam's official login page. After logging in, you'll be returned to SKINWAVE with your account connected. We never see or store your Steam password.
faq.g4a: Select your skins on the Sell page, choose a payout method, and confirm. We send you a trade offer via Steam. Once you accept, payment is processed instantly (or after trade hold ends). No marketplace listing, no waiting for buyers.
faq.g5a: Prices are based on current market data with our buyout modifier applied. You typically receive up to 95% of market value. Prices are displayed in your chosen currency and updated regularly.
faq.g6a: Always verify that trade offers come from our official bots. If a trade offer comes from an account not on our bot list, do not accept it. Contact support if you are unsure.
faq.p1a: You can deposit funds to your SKINWAVE balance by selling skins. Choose "Balance" as your payout method when selling - this has 0% commission. The funds are instantly available in your account.
faq.p2q: How can I withdraw my balance?
faq.p2a: Go to your Balance page, click "Cash Out", choose a withdrawal method (card, crypto, bank), enter the amount and your details. Your withdrawal request will be processed by our team.
faq.p3a: Card payouts are sent directly to your Visa or Mastercard. Enter your card details when choosing this method. Processing time is usually 1-3 business days depending on your bank. Fee: ~3%.
faq.p4a: Bank transfer payouts are sent directly to your bank account. Provide your bank details (IBAN or account number). Processing takes 2-5 business days. Fee: ~2%.
faq.p5a: Choose crypto as your payout method and enter your wallet address (Bitcoin or USDT). Payment is sent after we receive your items. Crypto transactions typically process within 10-30 minutes. Fee: ~1%.
faq.p6a: We offer Balance (0% fee), Debit Card (Visa/Mastercard), Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, USDT), and Bank Transfer. Available methods may vary by region.
faq.p7a: Each method has its own commission: Balance 0%, Crypto ~1%, Bank ~2%, Card ~3%. The exact fee is always shown before you confirm your order.
faq.s1q: How can I secure my account?
faq.s1a: Enable Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator. Never share your Trade URL publicly and regenerate it if compromised. We will never ask for your Steam password or login credentials.
faq.s2q: How do I avoid scams when selling skins?
faq.s2a: Always verify trade offers come from our official bots. Never click suspicious links or share your API key. SKINWAVE will never ask you to send items without a proper trade offer through Steam.
faq.t1a: A Trade URL is a unique link that allows us to send you a Steam trade offer. You need to provide it before selling. Find yours at: Steam → Settings → Privacy → Trade Offers → Copy your Trade URL.
faq.t2q: Why are items missing from my inventory?
faq.t2a: Make sure your Steam inventory is set to Public. Go to Steam → Profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings → set "Inventory" to "Public". Also check that items are not on trade hold or listed on another marketplace.
faq.t3q: Items are missing after I sold them?
faq.t3a: If items disappeared from your inventory after selling, the trade was completed successfully. Check your order status on the Orders page. If payment hasn't arrived, wait a few minutes - some methods take time to process. Contact support with your Order ID if the issue persists.
faq.t4a: A reversal hold occurs when Steam reverses a trade due to a dispute or suspected fraud. If this happens, the items are returned and any associated payout may be reversed. Contact support for assistance.
faq.c1a: CS2 skins are virtual cosmetic items for weapons in Counter-Strike 2. They come in various rarities and wear conditions (Factory New, Minimal Wear, Field-Tested, Well-Worn, Battle-Scarred). You can sell them on SKINWAVE for real money.
faq.c2q: How do I sell CS2 Skins?
faq.c2a: Sign in via Steam, go to the Sell page. Pick your CS2 skins, enter your Trade URL, choose a payout method and confirm. Accept the trade offer from our bot in Steam and receive your payout instantly.
faq.c3q: What is the CS2 trade hold?
faq.c3a: CS2 has a mandatory trade hold imposed by Valve. After accepting a trade, items may be held for up to 7 days before being delivered. Payment is processed after the hold ends. Other games (Dota 2, TF2, Rust) are not affected.
faq.c4q: Can I cancel a trade during CS2 hold?
faq.c4a: You can cancel a pending trade from your Steam inventory during the hold period. However, once the hold ends and items are delivered, the trade cannot be reversed. Contact our support team if you need assistance.
